# BetterCorella, Bohol

> An independent civic guide to the Municipality of Corella, Bohol, Philippines. It helps residents find municipal services, government contacts, barangay information, public records and national e-government portals. It is not the official municipal government website.

Information is published only after it is checked against an official source (the municipal government, PSA, DILG, BLGF, PhilGEPS, DPWH). Sections without verified data say so instead of guessing. Source dates vary by dataset; follow the linked source and verify time-sensitive details directly before acting.

## Main sections

- [Municipal services](/services): Requirements, fees and official forms from the Citizen's Charter, as they are verified.
- [Online services](/online-services): National e-government portals (eGov PH, Central Business Portal, PhilJobNet, PhilGEPS).
- [Municipal government](/government): Officials, offices, barangays and legislation.
- [Emergency hotlines](/government/hotlines): The national 911 and 8888 hotlines; local numbers once verified.
- [Town profile](/town): Facts about Corella from official sources.
- [Transparency](/transparency): Budget, procurement, infrastructure projects and open datasets.
- [News](/news): Municipal announcements linked to their official source.
- [About](/about): How the project works and where its data comes from.

## Project

- Source code: https://github.com/ashdroidcmd/bettercorella
- Report corrections: https://github.com/ashdroidcmd/bettercorella/issues
